name: Bun
description: Installs Bun - a fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, transpiler, and package manager

version.description: Select the version to install. Use 'latest' for stable release, 'canary' for pre-release features, or specify a version number (e.g., '1.1.0').

useBaseline.description: Install baseline build for older CPUs (Nehalem/Bulldozer) instead of default Haswell build. Use if you encounter 'Illegal Instruction' errors.

configurePath.description: Automatically configure PATH in shell profiles (.bashrc, .zshrc). Recommended for non-root users.
